verification_policy: Apply Now contains only exact official employer/ATS requisitions that exposed the specific job and an active Apply/application form during the 2026-09-04 review. Deduplication is by exact requisition: company-level confirmations never suppress other named roles. Cached snippets, generic careers shells, closed redirects and third-party mirrors remain discovery-only.
summary: Exact Gmail confirmations show that Sierra Agent New Grad, IMC Graduate Performance Engineer and NVIDIA China DL/HPC JR2024107 were submitted on September 3, so all three are removed from Apply Now. Six exact-live unapplied roles remain, led by CoreWeave Inference IC1. The strongest new human-review opportunities are Anthropic Performance Engineer, Inference Systems, OpenAI Training Performance Engineer and DeepMind Serving Quality; each is unlabeled and highly selective but lacks a hard years-level veto. Cerebras cannot support a part-time Winter internship, while the exact full-time Kernel Engineer New Grad process remains active with the hiring manager.
changes_today: Gmail exact-role reconciliation: Sierra Software Engineer, Agent (New Grad 2027), IMC Graduate Performance Engineer and NVIDIA JR2024107 were all confirmed submitted on 2026-09-03 and removed from Apply Now independently by exact requisition.

Cerebras update: the recruiter said the Winter 2027 internship cannot accommodate part-time work, but confirmed that a June 2027 full-time start is viable and would be discussed with the hiring manager. The exact Kernel Engineer - New Grad status remains Interview; no later scheduling message was present by the review cutoff.

New frontier stretch: Anthropic Performance Engineer, Inference Systems is a stronger and less kernel-centric fit than its GPU Performance opening. It emphasizes Python, profiling, latency/throughput analysis, SQL/pandas, distributed observability, correctness evals and LLM inference; the exact posting has no numeric years minimum and explicitly states visa sponsorship support.

New frontier stretch: OpenAI Training Performance Engineer directly matches multi-GPU distributed training, end-to-end profiling, collectives, scheduling, PyTorch and NCCL. It has no numeric years minimum and pays $295K-$500K plus equity; strong recent C++ and frontier-scale operational depth remain material gaps.

New frontier stretch: Google DeepMind Research Engineer, Serving Quality is an exact, separately unapplied requisition requiring Python or C++, ML/statistics and no numeric years. Experiment analysis, transformer training/serving efficiency, data quality and metrics map to AutoScout and production evaluation work.

New frontier stretch: Amazon Annapurna Labs SDE I, ML Infra Services is live with no years minimum and accepts internship/project experience, distributed systems, Linux profiling and optimization. Java proficiency is a material caveat, so it remains review-only rather than Apply Now.
All six retained Apply Now exact employer/ATS URLs and retained high-value-stretch pages were rechecked live on 2026-09-04.

Mandatory official sweep covered OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google DeepMind, Meta, NVIDIA, Microsoft AI, Amazon AGI/AWS AI, Waymo, Databricks, Cerebras, Together AI, Fireworks AI and CoreWeave. Roles with explicit multi-year, senior, clearance, pure-hardware or location/work-permit vetoes were kept out.

Public-source sweep rechecked Simplify, vanshb03, SpeedyApply SWE/AI, Zapply, ApplyGuy, Ricsign, Jobright and the Northwestern quant list. The best current sources are already integrated; no new adapter was added because no discovered source offered distinct high-quality coverage without material duplication or noise.
